title: Record a regression
responsibility: Run and preserve the failing-test commit or its unchanged passing fix.

inputs.name: recordRegression.input
inputs.description: Records red, green, or capture evidence for a loop; root defaults to process.cwd(), commit to HEAD, new-request test and unit arrays to [], and timeout to 600000 milliseconds. Capture defaults an omitted assertion to "Focused evidence capture completed."; new requests need a nonblank command and, outside capture, a nonblank assertion, selected units must be active at the tested commit, timeout must be an integer from 1 through 3600000, and a green fix reuses its red record and rejects supplied command, assertion, test, or unit values.

inputs.name: requireRegressionProof.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to locate loop state, Git history notes, and recorded regression proof.

inputs.name: requireRegressionProof.loop
inputs.description: Loop identifier whose red or paired green proof is checked against the current commit when the step requires proof.

inputs.name: requireRegressionProof.step
inputs.description: Step name that selects the required proof phase; only red, implement, green, guard, and verify trigger checks, while other strings return immediately.

inputs.name: enforceRegressionStep.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to locate the loop's retained regression evidence.

inputs.name: enforceRegressionStep.state
inputs.description: Current loop state; enforcement runs when regressionCommits is 1 or ordered steps have a pending red step, and a successfully checked starting red step sets regressionCommits to 1.

inputs.name: enforceRegressionStep.step
inputs.description: Step being advanced and passed to the proof check when enforcement is active.

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: A commit-linked result with the observed outcome and immutable evidence

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The implementation rejects when its fail checks detect an invalid phase, missing or changed paired proof, missing required command or assertion, invalid timeout, or invalid unit evidence. Errors from awaited Git, loop, repository, file, and proof-service calls can also propagate.

inputs.name: recordRegression.input
inputs.description: Records red, green, or capture evidence for a loop; root defaults to process.cwd(), commit to HEAD, new-request test and unit arrays to [], and timeout to 600000 milliseconds. Capture defaults an omitted assertion to "Focused evidence capture completed."; new requests need a nonblank command and, outside capture, a nonblank assertion, selected units must be active at the tested commit, timeout must be an integer from 1 through 3600000, and a green fix reuses its red record and rejects supplied command, assertion, test, or unit values.

outputs.name: recordRegression
outputs.description: Resolves to the value returned by RegressionProofService.run for the request, resolved commit, loop, phase, timeout, and any paired red proof; this file does not define that value's JSON shape.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The explicit fail paths reject with ExpectedCliError for an invalid phase, missing or mismatched proof/request fields, a missing command or assertion, an out-of-range timeout, or inactive unit evidence. Errors from awaited Git, loop, registry, file, and proof-service calls can also propagate.

inputs.name: requireRegressionProof.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to locate loop state, Git history notes, and recorded regression proof.

inputs.name: requireRegressionProof.loop
inputs.description: Loop identifier whose red or paired green proof is checked against the current commit when the step requires proof.

inputs.name: requireRegressionProof.step
inputs.description: Step name that selects the required proof phase; only red, implement, green, guard, and verify trigger checks, while other strings return immediately.

outputs.name: requireRegressionProof
outputs.description: Resolves with undefined after required proof checks pass; steps outside red, implement, green, guard, and verify are ignored.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects with ExpectedCliError when required red or green proof is missing, belongs to a different current commit, lacks its paired red record, or no longer matches the original regression. Errors from awaited proof and repository operations can also propagate.

inputs.name: enforceRegressionStep.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to locate the loop's retained regression evidence.

inputs.name: enforceRegressionStep.state
inputs.description: Current loop state; enforcement runs when regressionCommits is 1 or ordered steps have a pending red step, and a successfully checked starting red step sets regressionCommits to 1.

inputs.name: enforceRegressionStep.step
inputs.description: Step being advanced and passed to the proof check when enforcement is active.

outputs.name: enforceRegressionStep
outputs.description: Resolves with undefined when enforcement is not due or the required proof passes; after a successful starting red check it sets state.regressionCommits to 1.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Can reject with ExpectedCliError propagated from requireRegressionProof when enforcement is active and its proof check fails; errors from awaited proof operations also propagate.
